The '''1947–48 Serie A''' was the forty-sixth edition of the [[Italian Football Championship]]. It was the fifteenth Italian Football Championship [[brand]]ed [[Serie A]], since Serie A was launched in [[1929–30 Serie A|1929]]. This was the twenty-second season from which the Italian Football Champions adorned their team jerseys in the subsequent season with a [[Scudetto]]. [[Torino F.C.|Torino]] were champions for the fifth time in their [[history]]. This was their fifth scudetto since the scudetto started being awarded in [[1923–24 Prima Divisione|1924]] and their third win contested as Serie A. This was their fourth of five consecutive Italian Football Championship wins, punctuated by a two-year break due to [[World War II]].

==Teams==
[[Aurora Pro Patria 1919|Pro Patria]] for Northern Italy, [[A.S. Lucchese Libertas 1905|Lucchese]] for Central Italy and [[Salernitana]] for Southern Italy had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
